text:
Date
To whom it may concern,
Name Surname (Student number ) is a 3 rd year student in the Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics (MBG) at Gebze Technical University (GTU; Kocaeli/Turkey). As part of her/his studies, student name has been accepted to study for a period of 1 month (date-date) in Dr. Name surname’ group at the University of name of the university . Insurance for the student will be covered by GTU and living expenses will be his own responsibility After completing this study period, she/he will return to GTU and start her/his 4 th year education in her/his home country.
Best regards
Head of the MBG Department Head of the Internship Program
